blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Written from Jared's verified local notes (researched November 1, 2026). Listing-stated figures are labelled; unconfirmed items say so. No live listing feed or board statistics are attached to this page yet.
District council documents count Norgate among the District's Lower Capilano / Lions Gate neighbourhoods, and Norgate Park (279 Tatlow Ave) is a District park.
This guide covers Norgate's condo buildings, townhome complexes and land: what each source verifies, the local rules, and what buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
Condo buildings in Norgate

Norgate is in the District of North Vancouver (NOT the City) — District OCP Bylaw 7900 and Zoning Bylaw 3210 govern. Norgate's subdivision itself is almost entirely freehold single-family houses; its verified condo stock is the Marine Drive edge product in. All 9 verified North Vancouver 55+ strata sit outside Norgate — in-area seniors stock is rental/care/subsidized only. District = SD44 North Vancouver.
X61 — 1061 Marine Drive

Current listings record this building under the name X61, in the Norgate neighbourhood, Apartment/Condo form, built 2018, with pets recorded as Yes. Unit count and published rental restrictions: Not confirmed. No source states any age restriction. Counted: 1.
The Drive — 1177 Marine Drive (Onni)

The Drive by Onni is a mixed-use condo development at Marine and Bridgman; the developer's own homeowner guide is titled "The Drive – 1177 Marine," and current listings record units at 1177 Marine Drive in Norgate ("The Drive," MLS®). Listings record the complex as built 2012 (recorded at the 1330 address). Unit count for the 1177 building: Not confirmed. Published pet/rental restrictions for 1177: Not confirmed. No source states any age restriction. Counted: 1.
The Ivy — 1273 Marine Drive

Current listings describe "The Ivy, a boutique building in North Vancouver's welcoming Norgate neighbourhood," recording Apartment/Condo form, built 2012, cats OK, and the building as pet- and rental-friendly. Unit count: Not confirmed. No source states any age restriction. Counted: 1.
Streets, schools and getting around Norgate

items.t: District council documents count Norgate among the District's Lower Capilano / Lions Gate neighbourhoods, and Norgate Park (279 Tatlow Ave) is a District park.

Where condo stock concentrates: not inside the crescents — on the Marine Drive south edge. Every verified condo building in carries a Marine Drive address at the subdivision's southern boundary, facing the Lions Gate Village growth node at Capilano Road and Marine Drive.

Transit: the R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus runs along Marine Drive at the neighbourhood's south edge, between Park Royal and Metrotown Station (extended September 7, 2026; roughly 5 a.m.–2 a.m., every 6–7 minutes at peak); TransLink's Route 240 also runs the Marine Drive corridor, and the Marine Drive stops at Capilano Road and Pemberton Avenue are both named R2 RapidBus stops.

Schools and catchments: SD44 catchments are address-based. The neighbourhood elementary school is Norgate Xwemélch'stn Community Elementary (K–7, 1295 Sowden Street), an authorized IB World School offering the Primary Years Programme; the catchment secondary school is Carson Graham Secondary (2145 Jones Avenue).

The southern edge, along Welch Street, faces Capilano Indian Reserve No. 5 (X̱wemelch'stn), Squamish Nation land, where the Nation exercises its own land-use and zoning control; Welch Strip Park is the District park on the municipal side of that edge.

Hazards: Mackay Creek runs along the neighbourhood's east side toward the City boundary; the District designates Natural Hazard Development Permit Areas for slope and creek hazards and publishes property-level reports through GeoWeb.

Recreation: the Lions Gate Community Recreation Centre, 1733 Lions Gate Lane in Lower Capilano, is District-owned and NVRC-operated (opened June 4, 2022; gymnasium, kitchen, multipurpose and art spaces, no pool), housing the NVDPL Lions Gate Express Library.

items.t: District property taxes (2026): due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 1, 2026; the 2026 total residential rate is 3.28195 per $1,000 of assessed value (municipal rate 1.83419), and combined single-family utilities total $2,571 in 2026 (water $932.80; sewer/drainage $1,255.60). These are District rates — the City of North Vancouver's rates do not apply here.

blocks.text: Good to know about Norgate

items.t: The "City of North Vancouver" label in some listings for this bench is wrong. District 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026 with 5% + 5% penalties, and the total residential rate is 3.28195 per $1,000.
Norgate's condos are all on one street edge.

One developer complex straddles a board line. The Drive's two Marine Drive addresses fall in two different board sub-areas (1177 in Norgate, 1330 in Pemberton NV) — sub-area stats, school-search defaults and listing feeds will treat two halves of one complex as different neighbourhoods.
SnapStats publishes no North Vancouver figures at all.

The land across Welch Street is not District land and never will be planned by the District. It is Capilano IR No. 5 (X̱wemelch'stn). In October 2024 Squamish Nation Council approved mixed-use market residential, Nation housing and a new Administrative and Community Service Centre for the reserve's Marine Drive site — the southern outlook of Welch Street homes is an active development front.

The recreation centre for this bench has no pool. The Lions Gate Community Recreation Centre (1733 Lions Gate Lane, opened June 4, 2022) is District-owned and NVRC-operated with a gymnasium, kitchen, multipurpose and art spaces, the NVDPL Lions Gate Express Library and Capilano Community Services Society — and no pool.

East-edge lots need a creek check, not an assumption. Mackay Creek runs along the subdivision's east side, and the District's OCP Schedule B establishes Creek Hazard and Slope Hazard Development Permit Areas; the District's GEOweb flood construction levels are modelled on a 2100 (2080s) horizon plus 0.6 m.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Norgate
Streets, schools and getting around Norgate

items.t: Nearby areas: Pemberton Heights / Pemberton NV (north and east, also District), Lower Capilano (west), the City of North Vancouver (east, across the municipal boundary — a different municipality with different bylaws), and Park Royal / West Vancouver (west, across the Capilano River).
Where attached stock concentrates: not inside the crescents at all.

Schools: the neighbourhood elementary school is Norgate Xwemélch'stn Community Elementary (K–7, 1295 Sowden Street), an authorized IB World School offering the Primary Years Programme; the catchment secondary school is Carson Graham Secondary (Grades 8–12, 2145 Jones Avenue). Both names are Ministry-listed (SD44).

The southern edge: along Welch Street the subdivision faces Capilano Indian Reserve No. 5 (X̱wemelch'stn), Squamish Nation land, where the Nation exercises its own land-use and zoning control; Welch Strip Park is the District park on the municipal side of that edge. In October 2024 Squamish Nation Council approved land uses for the reserve's Marine Drive site — mixed-use market residential, Nation housing, and a new Administrative and Community Service Centre.

Recreation and hazards: Norgate Park, the subdivision's central green, has sports fields including a baseball diamond, soccer field and football field, and is home turf for the North Shore Cricket Club. The Lions Gate Community Recreation Centre, 1733 Lions Gate Lane in Lower Capilano, is District-owned and NVRC-operated (opened June 4, 2022; gymnasium, kitchen, multipurpose and art spaces, no pool), housing the NVDPL Lions Gate Express Library. Mackay Creek runs along the neighbourhood's east side; the District designates Natural Hazard Development Permit Areas and publishes property-level hazard reports through GeoWeb.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Norgate

items.t: Fee-simple reality — the governing frame inside the subdivision: A Norgate house purchase carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees — District municipal rules plus any registered covenants/HOA on title govern instead. Do not import strata expectations into a Norgate rancher purchase, or house expectations into a strata townhouse purchase in Lions Gate Village.

blocks.text: Good to know about Norgate

items.t: Norgate's townhouse count is zero — and that is the verified answer, not a research gap. A portal result that labels a Marine Drive apartment or a Curling Road townhouse as "Norgate" is a search-radius artefact.

One developer complex straddles the board line at the subdivision's edge. The Drive's two Marine Drive addresses fall in two different board sub-areas — 1177 Marine Drive in Norgate, 1330 Marine Drive in Pemberton NV — so sub-area stats and listing feeds treat two halves of one Onni complex as different neighbourhoods.

The elementary school's name carries the reserve relationship. Norgate Xwemélch'stn Community Elementary's bilingual name reflects the school community beside X̱wemelch'stn (Capilano IR No. 5) — the same Nation whose Marine Drive site, approved for mixed-use development in October 2024, faces the subdivision's Welch Street edge.

The District is trying to keep this bench out of provincial multiplex density. The March 2, 2026 Council motion sought an SSMUH exemption for the Lions Gate area — including Norgate — on the basis that it is better suited to development supporting rapid transit. The suite/coach-house permissions are real; the multiplex upside is contested District policy, lot by lot.

Single-level living on a level lot is the subdivision's real scarcity. Norgate is one of the few flat, single-storey pockets on the North Shore — post-war ranchers on crescents with minimal through traffic — which is why downsizer demand lands on houses here even though the area offers no townhouse or 55+ product at all.

blocks.text: Lots and land in Norgate
Fee-simple lots

items.t: : Norgate is a planned post-war subdivision (the "Norgate Park" development of the late 1940s–1950s) dominated by small post-war detached ranchers and bungalows on flat lots and crescent streets, with many homes since renovated, extended or replaced. The detailed history — that the land was first proposed for the Capilano Air Park airfield, and that original houses were modest (roughly 900–1,600 sq ft), many built slab-on-grade with radiant in-floor hot-water heating — is not verified from official sources: it rests on a heritage-society account, and no District or SD44 source states it. The documented form is fee-simple single-family lots; the pocket is historic built lot fabric, not an offering.

Lot character: flat subdivision lots on crescents and cul-de-sacs, with minimal through traffic inside the subdivision. Typical lot dimensions are not verified from an official source — no lot size, dimension or count is invented here. Confirm the parcel's dimensions and zone on title and District GeoWeb.

Serviced position, as stated: District single-family utilities in 2026 are water at $932.80 and sewer/drainage at $1,255.60 (combined single-family utilities $2,571 in 2026) — the serviced position for District lots as the District states it. A parcel-level servicing position beyond that wording: Not confirmed.

ALR vs non-ALR: no ALR parcel in Norgate is documented, and no ALR split is stated — this is urban subdivision ground inside the Urban Containment Boundary on the research record. A specific parcel's ALR status is a per-parcel check on ALC mapping in any event.

Hazard position: Schedule B of the District OCP establishes Development Permit Areas for Protection of the Natural Environment, Streamside Protection, Wildfire Hazard, Creek Hazard and Slope Hazard; the District's GEOweb flood construction level data is defined as modelled flood water levels for a 2100 (2080s) horizon plus 0.6 m. Whether any specific Norgate lot falls inside a mapped creek hazard DPA along Mackay Creek is property-specific — GeoWeb check required, not verified here.

blocks.text: What is NOT lot inventory on this ground

items.t: Marine Drive edge condos — built strata stock, NOT land
Townhouse stock: ZERO verified

Capilano IR No. 5 Marine Drive site — a development approval on Nation land, documented AS SUCH, never inventory: on October 29, 2024, Squamish Nation Council approved land uses for the Xwmélch'sten (Capilano) IR 5 Marine Drive site — mixed-use market residential developments, Nation housing, and a new Administrative and Community Service Centre. Its relevance to a Norgate lot buyer is the southern outlook: an active development front, not a static edge.

: the District's OCP (Bylaw 7900) directs 75–90% of growth to four centres and preserves established low-density neighbourhoods; Norgate's nearest growth node is the Lions Gate Village Centre at Capilano Road and Marine Drive, planned under the April 2013 Lower Capilano–Marine Village Implementation Plan.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Norgate

items.t: District council documents count Norgate among the District's four Lower Capilano neighbourhoods of the Lions Gate community, and Norgate Park (279 Tatlow Avenue) is a District park.

Nearby areas: Pemberton Heights (north), Lower Capilano (west), the City of North Vancouver (east, a different municipality), and Park Royal / West Vancouver (west, across the Capilano River). Buyers also search "Norgate Park" (the historic subdivision name), "Lower Capilano," and street searches around Tatlow Avenue, Garden Avenue and the crescents off West 19th Street.

Parks and hazards: Norgate Park, the subdivision's central green, has sports fields including a baseball diamond, soccer field and football field, and is home turf for the North Shore Cricket Club. The Lions Gate Community Recreation Centre, 1733 Lions Gate Lane in Lower Capilano, is District-owned and NVRC-operated (opened June 4, 2022; gymnasium, kitchen, multipurpose and art spaces, no pool). Mackay Creek runs along the neighbourhood's east side; the District designates Natural Hazard Development Permit Areas for slope and creek hazards and publishes property-level reports through GeoWeb.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Norgate

items.t: Zoning — District Zoning Bylaw 3210: since June 2024, District zoning permits a principal dwelling, a secondary suite and a coach house — three units total — on all single-family zoned properties within the Urban Containment Boundary; December 2023 changes let a secondary suite be up to 49% of the house with no minimum size and raised the maximum coach house height to two storeys.

SSMUH / subdivision potential, as the District states it: the District's GEOweb SSMUH classification shows non-exempt lots potentially allowing up to 3 units at 280 m² or less, up to 4 units above 280 m², and up to 6 units above 280 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit bus stop. Bill 25 (November 2025) requires full SSMUH density by June 30, 2026, but a March 2, 2026 District Council motion asked staff to pursue exempting the Lions Gate area — which includes Norgate — from SSMUH. Verify the specific lot's classification on GEOweb before pricing any density; do not price a Norgate lot on the 6-unit line.

Subdivision + servicing — District number HELD not confirmed: The documented process instead: subdivision potential runs off the parcel's zoning and SSMUH classification (above), servicing runs on the District's 2026 single-family utility structure (water $932.80; sewer/drainage $1,255.60; combined $2,571), and Schedule B hazard permit areas (below) gate creek-side and slope work. Confirm requirements with the District for the parcel.

Hazard development permits: Schedule B of the District OCP establishes Development Permit Areas for Protection of the Natural Environment, Streamside Protection, Wildfire Hazard, Creek Hazard and Slope Hazard, and the District publishes property-level hazard reports through GeoWeb. East-edge lots near Mackay Creek need that check before an addition, rebuild or split is assumed clean.

ALR rules (for completeness — no Norgate ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha).

District property taxes (2026): District of North Vancouver 2026 property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2, 2026 and a further 5% after September 1, 2026; the 2026 residential municipal rate is 1.83419 and the total residential rate is 3.28195 per $1,000 of assessed value.

Property transfer tax — worked example (inputs + tier math): on a $1,200,000 lot-and-house purchase, fully residential, no exemption — 1% on the first $200,000 ($2,000) + 2% on $200,000–$1,200,000 ($20,000) = $22,000. Anchors: $500K→$8,000; $800K cap→$14,000 ($6,000 fully qualifying FTHB); $900K→$16,000; $1.0M→$18,000; $1.5M→$28,000; $2.0M→$38,000; $3.5M→$93,000 INCLUDING the further 2% tier over $3M (tiers: 1% to $200,000, 2% to $2,000,000, 3% above, plus a further 2% on the residential portion over $3,000,000).

blocks.text: Good to know about Norgate

items.t: The Spirit Trail's route past Norgate was still a studied option, not a built fact. The North Shore Spirit Trail is planned as a fully accessible 35 km greenway from Horseshoe Bay to Deep Cove; the District's 2013 route planning report studied a Welch Strip option to improve connections to Park Royal and Ambleside via Bridge Street and to Kings Mill Walk via a planned crossing over the railway at Mackay Creek.

faq.q: How many apartment-condo buildings does Norgate have?
faq.a: Three verified by name, all on the Marine Drive south edge: X61 (1061 Marine Dr, built 2018), The Drive at 1177 Marine Dr (Onni, built 2012) and The Ivy (1273 Marine Dr, built 2012). The crescents inside the subdivision are freehold houses, not condos.

faq.q: Is Norgate in the City or the District of North Vancouver?
faq.a: The District. Norgate Park is a District park and District council documents count Norgate among the District's Lower Capilano neighbourhoods — the distinction changes the OCP (Bylaw 7900), the zoning bylaw (3210), the tax rates and the permit desk that apply.

faq.q: Is there any 55+ condo I can buy in Norgate?
faq.a: No — no verified 55+ ownership complex exists inside the sub-area. The maintained North Vancouver 55+ strata list names nine buildings and none is in Norgate; the closest are in Central Lonsdale, Delbrook, Edgemont and Lynn Valley. In-area seniors stock is rental/care/subsidized only.

faq.q: Can I rent out a Marine Drive condo long-term?
faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been void since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. The Ivy's listings already describe it as rental-friendly.

faq.q: One complex, two sub-areas — how does The Drive split?
faq.a: Listings record 1177 Marine Drive in Norgate and 1330 Marine Drive in Pemberton NV.

faq.q: My search keeps showing Curling Road townhouses for "Norgate." Whose are they?
faq.a: They are the nearest townhouse stock to Norgate and a legitimate cross-shop; they are just not Norgate stock.

faq.q: Is Norgate in the City or the District of North Vancouver?
faq.a: The District — a point buyers routinely get wrong. District OCP Bylaw 7900 and Zoning Bylaw 3210 govern, District taxes are billed by the District (due July 2, 2026; 5% penalty after July 2 and a further 5% after September 1, 2026), and the City of North Vancouver begins east across the boundary toward Calverhall, which IS City ground.

faq.q: Do I need a Form B or strata documents for a Norgate house?
faq.a: No. A subdivision house is fee-simple: NO strata, NO Form B, NO strata fees. Diligence is title (including any registered covenants), the District's GeoWeb hazard layer for east-edge lots near Mackay Creek, and inspection — including the heating system on original homes (next question).
